SELECT RIGHT ( a.input_param, LENGTH(a.input_param) - LENGTH(e.station_id) ) AS source_code, b.device_name AS source_name, ( CASE (c.mete_kind) WHEN 1 THEN '遥信' WHEN 2 THEN '遥测' WHEN 3 THEN '遥控' END ) AS source_type, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT( f.origin_id ) FROM u_patrol_plan_attr d LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance f ON f.instance_id = d.instance_id WHERE d.plan_id = a.plan_id ) AS device_id FROM `t_cfg_union_rule` a LEFT JOIN t_cfg_device b ON a.input_param = b.device_id LEFT JOIN t_cfg_mete c ON b.device_id = c.mete_id LEFT JOIN t_std_region e ON e.region_code = b.edge_code AND e.state = 1 WHERE b.edge_code = #{edgeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND c.edge_code = #{edgeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
